mapper.select: SELECT order_id AS orderId, provider_refund_id AS providerRefundId, source_event_id AS sourceEventId, status, amount, actor, reason_code AS reasonCode, reason_text AS reasonText, liability_party AS liabilityParty, merchant_liability_amount AS merchantLiabilityAmount, platform_liability_amount AS platformLiabilityAmount, requested_at AS requestedAt FROM order_refunds WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
